title: Grateful Dead Live at Assembly Hall - University Of Illinois on 1973-02-22

ai_review.summary: Tremendous soundboard capture of a high‑energy ’73 show, highlighted by an explosive Playing in the Band and scorching Me & My Uncle.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers crystal‑clear soundboard quality with every instrument distinct, letting the band’s fire shine through especially on the uptempo Playing in the Band, Me & My Uncle and Eyes of the World. While a few minor glitches (a Dark Star glitch and a brief cut on Goin’ Down the Road) are noted, the overall performance is vigorous and full of standout moments.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the show 4‑5 stars and praise both the musical energy and sound quality; only one review is moderate, and technical glitches are minor, leading to a strong overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound is described as tremendous and clear; occasional glitch in Dark Star at 4:42 and a slight cut on the first verse of Goin' Down the Road are noted.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Two‑set show with a strong first set featuring early ‘They Love Each Other’ and an aggressive Playing; second set offers high points like Me & My Uncle and Eyes of the World but includes some average material.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Aggressive lead guitar work highlighted during Playing in the Band and the twin‑guitar sections.
band_member_comments.Bob: Provides tight rhythm/dual‑guitar weave on Eyes of the World and other jams.
